title: +630 builds later, my Aztec pixel-art RPG Roguelike just got a massive update! [Playable Now]
author: Reckonerxy
selftext:
Hey folks! I've been showing my project around at live playtests and online, and I've been grinding hard to polish it up. Using Claude Opus 4.8 and Fable when available.

Recently, I added some new gods, new levels, and a massive UI overhaul. I’m really excited about the progress and would love to get this community's feedback on it!

**🔗 Check it out here:** [**https://reckonerxy.github.io**](https://reckonerxy.github.io)

For those who don't know, 🏛️ Teotlan: Land of Gods is a turn-based RPG/roguelite steeped in Mesoamerican mythology. You pick a Patron God (4 to start, 18 total to unlock) and build a team to conquer the 9 layers of the Aztec Underworld.

Let me know what you think if you give it a spin! Thanks so much! 🙏
